about_the_game:
With Earth on the brink of annihilation, you step into the boots of the last surviving space marines. As a robot army is plotting to hurl a colossal asteroid into the planet you must embark on high-stakes missions where you'll engage in space battles and infiltrate enemy bases to prevent the Doomsday asteroid from wiping out humanity.

Dynamic Environments and Physics

With procedurally generated layouts, enemy placements and loot, no two playthroughs are the same. The destructible voxel based environments add a tactical layer to combat—blast through walls or create new paths to outmanoeuvre enemies and change the battlefield in real time.

Space Combat

Feel the rush of space combat with ships that obey Newtonian physics—thrust, mass, and momentum.

Ray Tracing

Experience ray traced visuals with a custom engine designed for dynamic shadows, reflections, and transparency. Combined with the destructible block-based environments, it creates a fully immersive and visually stunning experience.

Asteroids

Explore the labyrinthine tunnel systems and use them to infiltrate and escape enemy asteroid bases.

name: Elimin8

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X or Intel i5 9600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060/3050 or AMD 6600
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A graphics card that supports hardware ray tracing is required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel i5 12400F
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060TI, AMD RX 6700 XT or better
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A graphics card that supports hardware ray tracing is required

short_description: Elimin8 is a fast-paced single-player spaceship shooter and FPS. Featuring destructible environments, realistic physics and ray traced graphics you take the role of the last surviving space marines, your mission is to overcome the robot army and prevent them from destroying Earth!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
